about: The module that implements each engine's part, by engine, kept apart from engine_knobs.json so a reader of the knob rows does not load the adapters. adapter: the module workflow/tune.py loads (tune.table merges it into engines.<E>) to read that engine's build, supply its facts, run its measured points and write its command. mtp: the module collectors/mtp.py loads to measure the engine's multi-token prediction. build: the engine's one build resolver (module:function, a build given as any of its programs -> the program a run starts; none given -> the one found), which tune, Measure MTP (--build) and session-ab (the server command's program and an arm's) all go through; an engine with none runs a program as it is given. out_of_memory: the engine's own words when a GPU allocation fails, a regular expression over its log, read only where no structured signal says why a process failed (its exit status says that it failed, not why): load-probe's out-of-memory label and the llama-server driver's reason. fit_words: llama.cpp's own words for its -fit outcome (common/fit.cpp), which it says only in its log, read by the llama-server driver's fit probe. version_words: vLLM's build in a retained log, for evidence recorded before replay read its /version. Each is tested against the pinned engine's source (tests/test_load_probe.py).

probe_log.where: load-probe reads the server's buffer sizes (model, context, compute) from its log, which llama-server prints only at log level 4 (trace) and above (the library's INFO lines, among them the KV, output and compute buffer sizes, log at level 4: common/log.cpp:551 at b12521): -lv, --verbosity, --log-verbosity N (default 3; common/arg.cpp, the b12521 build's --help: 0 generic, 1 error, 2 warning, 3 info, 4 trace, 5 debug); -v/--verbose logs everything. A command or environment that sets a level keeps its own

switch_log.where: a mod's switch that its code turns off at load says so in the server log: '<function>: LLAMA_IDX_POOLED ignored: needs ... one sequence ...' (llama-memory-hybrid-idx.cpp:142, :617; llama-kv-stream.cpp:37-41 at b12521 + the modules)

kernel_list.where: the kernel hook's loader: arkey_ie_mods engines/llama.cpp/b12521/patches/kernels.patch, ext_load and ext_load_entry (ggml-cuda/ext-kernels.cpp)

log.dropped: ext_load: entry (\S+) dropped, the engine's own kernel runs: ([^\n]*)
log.unused: ext_load: (.+?) not used, the engine's own kernels run: ([^\n]*)

kernel_list.why: log: the lines the loader writes for each entry of the list GGML_CUDA_EXT_KERNELS names (loaded ID (N ops); entry ID dropped: why; the list not used: why), read by session-ab from each server's log: what binds a measured arm to the kernel it ran

graph_stats.why: the graph-cap mod's stats line (GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_STATS=1, arkey_ie_mods llama.cpp/graph-cap): one per graph executable built, with its backend context, its graph and its chunk; a context's chunks a graph = the highest chunk + 1 = ceil(nodes of its largest CUDA split graph / the chunk size)

llama.cpp.out_of_memory: \b[A-Za-z]+ error: (out of memory|the resource allocation failed)|cudaMalloc failed|failed to allocate (?!CPU)[A-Za-z]+\d* buffer|ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory|hipErrorOutOfMemory

fit_words.failed: failed to fit params to free device memory
fit_words.error: encountered an error while trying to fit params to free device memory
fit_words.by_context: entire model can be fit by reducing context

vllm.out_of_memory: torch\.OutOfMemoryError|CUDA out of memory|CUDA error: out of memory
